description: GROWL provides attributes and long-term water-level or storage series for 4,134 reservoirs. Components include CSV metadata, individual time series, a WGS84 point shapefile and a README linking original sources. This resource is provided by Mingyang Zhang; Gang Zhao; Chunqiao Song and coauthors. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV, MD, ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Monitoring periods and variable availability differ among reservoirs; global coverage does not imply uniform observations. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
